bugs.title: The request page and Inbox don't refresh after a backend change made elsewhere (Demo phone accept or decline, or the background read of a request that came in by text)
bugs.evidence: flow-b-accept-by-text: after typing 'ok' on the Customer phone, the API had already booked the request (GET /api/inbox/req-04 -> status=accepted, quote.status=accepted; the Driver phone shows 'New stop today. Lakeshore Dental ... about 4:15pm'). The open request page still showed the status chip 'Quoted' and the quote as 'Sent', and its option cards were still listed, even though the 'Booked: Lakeshore Dental' bar was showing (screenshot flow-b-accept-by-text-failure.png). Same thing for the decline: the inbox-row-2 chip stayed 'Quoted' after the Customer phone declined, and it only showed Declined after a page reload. customer-text-and-ask-customer: GET /api/inbox/req-15 shows source=text, status=priced, 6 details, read_at set. The request page opened right after it was created kept showing 'Not read yet' for 60s.
bugs.suggested_fix: After a phone accept or decline, reload the open request and the inbox list (for example by bumping a shared reload key in DemoPhones' afterBooking/act), or poll the request while a read or quote is pending.

action_items.detail: JRN-88: the phone's typing indicator only appears before INCOMING messages. When the customer types a new request, nothing comes back, so no typing indicator shows. The journey expects one. Either add an incoming acknowledgement or clarify the journey.

The Fleet map's default zoom at 1440x900 fits all vans, so the clusters are small and you can barely see the map tiles. The van icons, numbered stops, round controls, filter pills with counts and lime toggles are all there. The Van 2 page matches the reference well: a floating card with Stop 9 of 22, next stop, striped progress bar, a 91% Day used dial and a 50 Spare minutes tile, and the route in lime.
